description: The BLOND GitHub repository contains Python scripts, services and utility code used to collect and verify its building-level electricity measurements. The README identifies data acquisition and checks around the office waveforms, with dependencies including h5py, NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib and RQ. A modeller working with BLOND can inspect or adapt these preparation steps before using the measured voltage and current in an appliance or building-energy simulation. The tool does not by itself distribute the forty-terabyte waveform dataset, and its original acquisition setup is specific to one German office. GitHub reports an MIT licence for the code. The repository is a separate resource from the mediaTUM data record already in the catalogue. I read repository metadata and README, but did not clone or run the scripts, so compatibility with current Python releases is untested. Its coverage is the single German office monitored for BLOND in 2016–2017. It complements the related catalogue data record, not replacing its HDF5 measurements.
